The Certificate

What It Covers

The certificate covers two measures: loft insulation (B9) and pitched roof insulation (B10). It was issued on 6 November 2026 and runs until 5 November 2027.

Spray foam removal, roof repairs and new roofs are not on it, so we don't describe that work as PAS 2030 certified.
